en_title: Final James Bond Screen Tests Are Underway With Jack Lowden, Callum Turner, and Others on the Shortlist
subtitle: 谁会穿上燕尾服？
opus_summary: 《007》新任詹姆斯·邦德的最终试镜预计本周举行，Jack Lowden、Callum Turner和Josh O'Connor进入候选名单，另有一名演员身份未明。

paragraphs.en: Reports suggest that the final James Bond screen tests are underway, with actors like Jack Lowden and Callum Turner on the shortlist.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，《007》新任詹姆斯·邦德的最终试镜已经开始，Jack Lowden和Callum Turner等演员进入候选名单。

paragraphs.en: As reported by both Deadline and The Hollywood Reporter , final screen tests for the next Bond are expected to take place this week. As it stands, there's only a small handful of actors still in the running to become 007. Jack Lowden and Callum Turner have both been corroborated by the two outlets, but Deadline also noted that Josh O'Connor is also in the mix.
paragraphs.cn: Deadline和好莱坞报道者均报道称，新任詹姆斯·邦德的最终试镜预计将在本周举行。目前仍有望饰演007的演员只剩少数几人。两家媒体都确认Jack Lowden和Callum Turner在候选之列，但Deadline还指出，Josh O'Connor也参与了竞争。

paragraphs.en: A fourth actor is also rumored to be in the mix, though it's unclear who. The Hollywood Reporter ruled out Jack O'Connell as the fourth mystery actor. Both Deadline and THR noted that Jacob Elordi is not testing for the role, despite having previously been rumored . The actors who are up for the part are expected to be tested on stunts, dialogue, and camera presence.
paragraphs.cn: 据传还有第四名演员参与竞争，但目前尚不清楚此人是谁。好莱坞报道者排除了Jack O'Connell作为这名神秘演员的可能性。Deadline和好莱坞报道者都指出，Jacob Elordi没有参加该角色的试镜，尽管此前曾有传闻称他是候选人。参与竞逐的演员预计将接受特技、台词和镜头表现方面的考察。

paragraphs.en: As a result, we can likely expect the next Bond to be announced sometime in November or December. The film will be director Denis Villeneuve's next project following the release of Dune Part 3, though it currently has no release date. Though, if production begins next year, it could release in late 2028. The film already has a script, so it's just a matter of assembling all of the pieces.
paragraphs.cn: 因此，我们或许可以期待新任詹姆斯·邦德在11月或12月的某个时候公布。这部电影将是导演Denis Villeneuve在《Dune Part 3》上映后的下一部作品，但目前还没有确定上映日期。不过，如果影片明年开拍，可能会在2028年年底上映。电影已经有了剧本，接下来只需把各个环节筹备到位。

paragraphs.en: Casting for the next Bond has been underway since spring , and there has been no shortage of rumors about who will don the tux. Although Jack Lowden appears to be a favorite among fans, ex-Bond actor Daniel Craig told IGN last year that he was rooting for Josh O'Connor and joked that he started a rumor that he was up for the part. Now, it seems that joke has actually become reality, with O'Connor as a finalist.
paragraphs.cn: 新任詹姆斯·邦德的选角工作从春季开始一直在进行，关于谁会穿上那身燕尾服的传闻也从未停过。虽然Jack Lowden似乎是粉丝最看好的人选，但前任邦德演员Daniel Craig去年告诉IGN，他支持Josh O'Connor，还开玩笑说是自己散布了Josh O'Connor参与竞选的传闻。如今看来，这个玩笑似乎真的成了现实，O'Connor已经成为最终候选人。

paragraphs.en: We also have no idea what the new direction will be for James Bond. The Daniel Craig films were more grounded and serious, something that would likely lend itself to Denis Villeneuve's style. It seems unlikely we'll get another origin story since Casino Royale did that so tactfully, and 007 First Light also successfully put its own spin on things earlier this year. Early reports suggested that producers were eyeing a younger Bond, but all three of the named candidates are 36 years old, just two years younger than Craig was in Casino Royale. It's possible the direction has changed, but it may come at the cost of longevity.
paragraphs.cn: 我们同样不知道《詹姆斯·邦德》系列接下来会采取怎样的新方向。Daniel Craig主演的几部电影更加写实、严肃，这种风格或许很适合Denis Villeneuve。我们似乎不太可能再次看到邦德起源故事，毕竟《皇家赌场》已经十分巧妙地讲述过这一内容，而《007 First Light》也在今年早些时候成功加入了自己的诠释。早期报道曾称制片人正在寻找更年轻的邦德，但目前已知的三名候选人都36岁，比Craig出演《皇家赌场》时只年轻两岁。系列方向可能已经发生变化，但这或许会以牺牲角色长期延续性为代价。

paragraphs.en: Craig was injured many times during his tenure as James Bond , and the stunts became more difficult as he got older . Maybe the producers don't intend on having the next Bond play the role for 15 years like Craig, though.
paragraphs.cn: Craig饰演詹姆斯·邦德期间曾多次受伤，随着年龄增长，特技动作也变得更加困难。不过，制片人或许并不打算让下一任邦德像Craig一样出演这个角色15年。
